Info.title: Data sets
Info.desc: Half-bridge module: meshes, data sets and operating points (genBoardPFHB.py)
Info._note: Edit the values only. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. 'CHANGE' marks parameters that depend on the computer (GPU memory, runtime); all other values are those of the paper.

coarse._dx: Coarse grid: lateral grid spacing dx = dy of the coarse mesh (mm)
coarse._dz: Coarse row height: maximum height of a node row of the coarse mesh (mm)
coarse._row: Coarse rows per layer: maximum number of node rows per layer of the coarse mesh

medium._dx: Medium grid: lateral grid spacing of the medium mesh (mm)
medium._dz: Medium row height: maximum height of a node row of the medium mesh (mm)
medium._row: Medium rows per layer: maximum number of node rows per layer of the medium mesh

fine._dx: Fine grid: lateral grid spacing of the fine mesh (mm)
fine._dz: Fine row height: maximum height of a node row of the fine mesh (mm)
fine._row: Fine rows per layer: maximum number of node rows per layer of the fine mesh

Sets._nTrain: Training boards: labelled boards of the training set (condition and chip positions vary, centres outside the band x_c = 12-16 mm); do not change for the paper (all results depend on the data sets)
Sets._nProf: Profiles per training board: random operating-point profiles per training board; do not change for the paper (all results depend on the data sets)
Sets._nVal: Validation boards: labelled boards of the validation set (early stopping); do not change for the paper (all results depend on the data sets)
Sets._nPhys: Physics-only boards: boards without simulation (only C, G, Bp) for the physics loss of the network; do not change for the paper (all results depend on the data sets)
Sets._nT1: Test boards T1: boards of the test set T1 (inside the training domain); do not change for the paper (all results depend on the data sets)

Prof._Ts: Sampling time: sampling time of all profiles and models (s)
Prof._tEnd: Profile length: length of the training, validation and test profiles T1-T3 (s)
Prof._t4End: Mission length: length of the drive-cycle mission T4 (from cold) (s)
Prof._dec: Field decimation: the full temperature field is stored every dec samples (POD snapshots, field errors); the sensors are stored at every sample

Op._Vdc: DC-link voltage: DC-link voltage of the half-bridge (V)
Op._Tj: Junction temperature: junction temperature of the device parameters (fixed, linear thermal model) (degC)
Op._Imax: Maximum current: maximum phase current amplitude of the random operating points (0 ... Imax) (A)
Op._foMin: Minimum output frequency: minimum output frequency (start-up, stall: losses alternate between high and low side) (Hz)
Op._foMax: Maximum output frequency: maximum output frequency (nominal operation: high and low side carry the same mean loss) (Hz)
Op._holdMin: Minimum hold time: minimum duration of a random operating point (s)
Op._holdMax: Maximum hold time: maximum duration of a random operating point (s)
